why: The case's interact already has a `prop` - the stone button is the affordance, and the compiler summons no lantern beside a prop. Writing `marker` on it declares a value the world will never reflect: `shown` would be a lie and `hidden` is redundant. Either is refused, because a field that binds to nothing is the shape every other probe here exists to catch. It declares no unit: `marker` is bound on the interact-free reaches and on the valley overlay's reach; what must not compile is a marker on a prop.
